sentences.zh: 看着它，既有保护又完全开放，这样你就能真正融入其中。

sentences.en: Cities all change and have to change.
sentences.zh: 城市都在变化，也必须改变。

sentences.en: And anyone who wants to keep it frozen and waxed so that it forever looks like a 1938 model
sentences.zh: 任何想要把它冰封并打蜡，让它永远看起来像1938年模型的人

sentences.en: is delusional and is going to be disappointed.
sentences.zh: 都是在妄想，而且注定会失望。

sentences.en: This is the issue that everyone's trying to grapple with in this city is how do we preserve it
sentences.zh: 这座城市的每个人都在努力解决的问题是，我们如何在保持其所有辉煌的同时，

sentences.en: in all of its glory, but at the same time make place as dynamic as possible
sentences.zh: 让这个地方尽可能充满活力，

sentences.en: and make it as hospitable as possible?
sentences.zh: 并尽可能让人感到热情好客？

sentences.en: It won't look exactly like the 1938 model.
sentences.zh: 它不会长得跟1938年的模型一模一样。

sentences.en: It won't even look like the 2019 version.
sentences.zh: 它甚至不会看起来像2019年的版本。

sentences.en: And I think that there's a way of achieving it without losing what makes it special.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为有一种方法可以实现这一点，同时又不失其特殊之处。

sentences.en: Hopefully we can make a start.
Well, it seems there are the beginnings of a new consciousness
sentences.zh: 嗯，在旧金山的新一代积极分子中，

sentences.en: in a new generation of activists in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 似乎已经萌生了一种新的意识。

sentences.en: And it seems to be a kind of wave of the future with a new coalition of young progressives
sentences.zh: 这似乎是未来的一种潮流，伴随着由年轻进步人士组成的新联盟，

sentences.en: that includes not only the Green Movement, but also groups like the Bicycle Coalition
sentences.zh: 其中不仅包括绿色运动，还包括自行车联盟等组织，

sentences.en: with its vision of a carless city, alternative cultural institutions.
sentences.zh: 以及他们对无车城市和另类文化机构的构想。

sentences.en: There are also poetic rappers, seniors for peace and performance artists, farmers markets selling
sentences.zh: 这里还有充满诗意的说唱歌手、争取和平的老年人和行为艺术家、出售当地农产品的农夫市场，

sentences.en: local produce, raising the possibility of a self-sustaining eco-region free from ecologically
sentences.zh: 这唤起了一种可能：一个自给自足的生态区域，摆脱了生态灾难般的农业综合企业。
这是美国未来可能出现的一种社会愿景，当然，它还有待实现。

sentences.en: It's a vision of a possible future society in America that, of course, has yet to be realized.
sentences.zh: 但这确实存在于我们的意识中。

sentences.en: But it does exist in our consciousness.
